behavior: Configuration writes track every positive native reply before adapter postprocessing. Later local not_sent/generic failures become unknown, runtime uncertainty is retained, and another write cannot be dispatched. Original unknown errors stay unknown; actual pre-positive rejection and revoked final owner remain not_sent.

Only four bounded remote/account display adapters tolerate JSON-schema-optional nullable response fields: manual pairing code absent means no manual code; absent remote default cwd clears selection; absent remote client cursor becomes null; missing accountId/reset credits become explicit null and cannot authorize spending or email.

Official TypeScript declarations require these nullable fields; JSON schemas permit omission. These compatibility changes do not assert a reproduced omission by the actual pinned CLI. History/model/MCP/organization completeness contracts are unchanged.
